summary: xAI added image, video, and voice reference support, text-to-video generation, and native 1080p output to its Grok Imagine Video 1.5 model, available in the app and API.

mechanisms.reason: Native 1080p video generation increases the resolution and data volume produced per generation, implying higher compute/memory footprint per request, though this is not stated explicitly.
mechanisms.quote: Native 1080p is now supported with text-to-video and image-to-video.

mechanisms.reason: Broader rollout of the feature across all subscription tiers implies more users generating video, increasing aggregate inference volume.
mechanisms.quote: rolling out to all tiers over the next few days

practices.reason: Engineers building on Grok's video API can now pass image and voice references to lock character identity and voice consistency across generated scenes, and generate video directly from text at native 1080p.
practices.quote: Pass in a character image and a voice reference, and both hold — the same face and the same voice in every scene.

practices.reason: The API now exposes new parameters (reference_image_urls, resolution) and a model name that teams integrating the video API need to adopt.
practices.quote: Image references, text-to-video, and native 1080p are live in the xAI API with our best video model, grok-imagine-video-1.5 .
